name: useBatteryShare
summary: Google Pixel Battery Share (Reverse Wireless Qi Charging) telemetry and actuator.
plain: Monitors and controls the phone's reverse wireless charging transmitter coil to share battery power with accessories like Pixel Buds or other Qi devices docked on the back.
description: Directly interfaces with the Google Pixel reverse wireless charging subsystem (/sys/class/power_supply/wireless/reverse_chg_mode). Reports whether wireless power transfer is active, whether a compatible Qi receiver is docked, real-time power transmission in watts, and allows programmatically enabling or disabling power transfer with safety cutoff thresholds.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether this device hardware supports reverse wireless power transmission.

returns.name: isActive
returns.desc: Whether the Qi TX reverse charging coil is currently energized.

returns.name: isReceiverDetected
returns.desc: Whether a compatible Qi receiver device is docked on the reverse charging coil.

returns.name: transmittedWatts
returns.desc: Real-time power transmitted in watts (W), or null if inactive/unsupported.

returns.name: batteryThreshold
returns.desc: Configured battery percentage cutoff threshold (stops sharing below this percentage).

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if reading or toggling the coil failed.

returns.name: setBatteryShare
returns.desc: Toggles reverse wireless power transmission on or off.

returns.name: setBatteryThreshold
returns.desc: Sets the safety battery cutoff percentage (e.g. 15%).

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-reads the reverse wireless charging subsystem status.

actions.name: setBatteryShare(enabled)
actions.desc: Turns reverse wireless charging on or off.

agentNote: Supported on Google Pixel 5 and later flagship models with reverse wireless charging coils.
